translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content: “Tsɔ wò abolo da ɖe tsi dzi”

content.text: Na nu amewo faa
elabena wò nunana atrɔ ava wò ŋutɔ
gbɔwò gbe aɖe gbe emegbe.
Ma wò nunanawo ɖe akpa adre alo akpa enyi me
elabena ɖewohĩ wò ŋutɔ ahiã kpekpeɖeŋu geɖe
le ŋkeke siwo ava la me.
Ne tsi sɔ gbɔ ɖe lilikpowo me la, tsi dzana.
Ne ati aɖe mu eye wòdze dziehe alo anyiehe gome la,
etsia afi si wòdze.
Ame si léa ŋku ɖe ya ƒe ƒoƒo ŋu la,
meƒãa nu o eye ame si léa ŋku ɖe lilikpowo ŋu la,
meŋea nu o.
Mawu ƒe mɔwo le manyamanya me na mí
abe ale si míenya ya ƒe toƒe o
kple ale si ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ gena ɖe vidzĩ
ƒe lãme le esime vidzĩ la le dadaa ƒe dɔme la o ene.
Nɔ wò nukuwo ƒaƒã dzi ko,
elabena màte ŋu anya esiwo agbe miemie o;
ɖewohĩ wo katã amie.

content: Ɖo ŋku wò Wɔla dzi le wò ɖekakpuime.

content.text: Enye nu nyui wɔnuku aɖe be ame nanɔ agbe!
Ele be ame si tsi, xɔ ƒe geɖe la,
nakpɔ dzidzɔ gbe sia gbe le eƒe agbe me,
ke wòaɖo ŋku viviti ƒe ŋkekewo dzi,
elabena woasɔ gbɔ, eye nu siwo
le agbe sia me la nye tofloko sɔŋ ko,
ne wotsɔ wo sɔ ɖe agbe kemɛ tɔwo ŋu.
Ɖekakpui, kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ɖekakpuime,
eye nàna wò dzi naɖu agbe le wò ɖekakpuime.
Zɔ ɖe wò dzi ƒe didi kple wò ŋku ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu,
ke nyae be
Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò le nu siawo katã ta,
eya ta ɖe nuxaxa ɖa le wò dzime,
eye nàte nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖa xaa tso wò ŋutilã gbɔ,
elabena ɖekapuimenɔnɔ
kple ŋutsumeɖoɖo hã nye tofloko ko.
